root_cause: safe_ratio divides by den without checking it: CBMC reports 'division by zero in num / den' (safe_ratio.division-by-zero.1, src/safe_ratio.c line 8) with den = 0, and UBSan aborts the zero_den test with 'runtime error: division by zero'. The harness postcondition rc == SAFE_RATIO_ERR_DIV_ZERO fails for the same input.
rationale: Reject a zero divisor before dividing and report SAFE_RATIO_ERR_DIV_ZERO without writing *out; the NULL-out check keeps precedence. The quotient itself is unchanged. (This mock proposal deliberately addresses only the division-by-zero failure, to demonstrate a multi-round repair.)
